description: This file contains a Java test class 'EventCoapIT' used for integration testing of the CoAP adapter in the Eclipse Hono project. It extends a base test class and implements methods to create message consumers and generate resource URIs for testing events over CoAP.

classes.name: EventCoapIT
classes.description: A JUnit test class for testing CoAP event interactions in the Eclipse Hono framework, extending 'CoapTestBase' and utilizing VertxUnitRunner.

methods.name: createConsumer
methods.description: Creates a message consumer for a specific tenant that processes messages with a provided consumer function.

methods.name: getPutResource
methods.description: Generates the URI for a device-specific PUT resource based on tenant and device ID.

methods.name: getPostResource
methods.description: Returns the fixed URI for POST requests to the event endpoint.

methods.name: getMessageType
methods.description: Returns the CoAP message type used in the test, which is Confirmable (CON).
